name: stars-digest-dev
description: Anchors the Genkit CLI (`genkit start`) project root to this Dart package. The genkit JS CLI locates the project root by walking up for a package.json; without this file it climbs past the repo and watches the wrong .genkit/runtimes directory, so the Dev UI never connects to the Dart reflection server (which registers under this package's .genkit/runtimes). Dart tooling ignores this file.
